core_obligations: Fibres are quasi-compact: a point of the Hausdorff target is closed, so its preimage is a closed subset of a quasi-compact space (proof lines 3483-3486)
Reduce by the properness characterization: it suffices to prove that the map is closed (proof lines 3487-3489)
Closedness: a closed subset of the source is quasi-compact, its image is quasi-compact and a quasi-compact subset of a Hausdorff space is closed (proof lines 3490-3494)
proof_roadmap: Y 是 Hausdorff ⇒ 每点是闭集 ⇒ 纤维 f^{-1}(y) 是 X 的闭子集 ⇒ 准紧。
由「proper ⟺ 闭 + 纤维准紧」的刻画，只需证 f 闭。
闭 E ⊂ X ⇒ E 准紧 ⇒ f(E) 准紧 ⇒ f(E) 闭（Hausdorff 中准紧集闭）。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a continuous map from a quasi-compact space to a Hausdorff space is universally closed (author lemma at source lines 3473-3481, label lemma-closed-map). The proof (source lines 3483-3495) checks quasi-compactness of the fibres, reduces by the properness characterization to closedness and runs the chain closed implies quasi-compact implies quasi-compact image implies closed (proof lines 3483-3494). The chain and the reduction are the substance. H3.
